author: hasl
body:
Hello, just going to say Good Luck to you all of who will apply tomorrow, I hope everyone who deserves it shall get it!
 I've applied many times on past servers, big like this, and I sometimes got freaked and applied without spending time on my app. If that's going to be you, just wait for next time!
From my past experience I've spent weeks on one app, so just write what comes!
Dont get worried for interviews, just look at it as a questioning for your skills!
Ive seen so many keen players, and I hope you apply!
If you think your a rather small player and the big guys at the top are like going to 360*NoScope#RektYouSoHard you, well... its not COD so don't worry :)
Just give it your absolute best!
I personally am not going to apply and won't in the next time either, even though I'm an old player, I'm not known, popular, praised, or contributing to projects.

So just another Massive GOOD LUCK to everyone that's going to apply! 

.

.
